linkAddress.lost: The address of this link is not stored: it dates from before 2026-09-24. It continues to work. If you need the address, create a new link with the same scope and revoke this one afterwards.

dialog.title: Share “{title}”
dialog.description: Sharing means: someone outside this workspace can access this page. Anyone who is already a member here does not need a share.
dialog.inherited: This page is already shared from higher up: someone shared an area above it along with everything underneath. It is therefore already accessible from the outside without anything listed here.
dialog.publicLinkExplanation: Anyone with the address can view the page: without an account, without signing in, even if it was forwarded to them. Nobody can edit via a link.
dialog.addressKept: You can find the address again anytime, here in the list and under “Shares” in the account menu, as long as the link is active.
dialog.nobody: Nobody outside this workspace can access this page.

mine.intro: Everything you have shared yourself, across all workspaces: with individual accounts and via public link.
mine.emptyDescription: You haven’t shared a page yet. You can do that in the page menu via “Share…”.
mine.noneOpenDescription: All your shares have been revoked or have expired.
mine.truncated: There are more shares than shown here. The oldest inactive ones are missing.
mine.adminOnly: Only admins in workspace “{workspace}” can revoke here.

incoming.intro: Pages from workspaces where you aren’t a member. They don’t appear in any navigation, only here.
incoming.emptyDescription: When someone shares a page with you, it will appear here.

workspace.title: Shares
workspace.intro: What has been shared externally from this workspace: with individual accounts and as a public link. Revoked shares remain listed so you can keep track of what was once accessible.
workspace.emptyDescription: No page in this workspace is accessible externally.

public.goneTitle: This link no longer leads to a page
public.goneDescription: It was revoked, has expired, or was never valid. Ask the person who gave it to you.
public.footer: This page was shared as a link. It is read-only. <link>eXocortex</link> is self-hosted.

shared.unavailableDescription: The share was revoked, has expired, or never existed.
